query:
SELECT 
  u.id as userId,
  u.email,
  ut.type as userType,
  o.id as organizationId,
  o.name as organizationName,
  b.id as branchId,
  b.name as branchName
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN user_types ut ON u.id = ut.userId
LEFT JOIN organizations o ON u.id = o.ownerId
LEFT JOIN branches b ON o.id = b.organizationId
WHERE u.email = 'dedzocharles37@gmail.com'
ORDER BY u.id, o.id, b.id;
